status: STUDIO POLICY - DOCUMENTED / HUMAN PROOF REQUIRED FOR ASSETS

entries.name: Straight cut
entries.mechanism: Immediate image replacement without blending
entries.creative_use: Default for all storytelling; pace and emotional punctuation

entries.name: Cut on action
entries.mechanism: Join an action across two angles at its most readable motion point
entries.failure_check: Direction and limb state must agree

entries.name: Eyeline match
entries.mechanism: Cut from gaze to spatially coherent object or person
entries.creative_use: Point of view and audience attention

entries.name: Shot/reverse-shot
entries.mechanism: Alternate viewpoints across established conversation axis

entries.name: Reaction cut
entries.mechanism: Leave action to reveal another person's specific response

entries.name: Cut-in
entries.mechanism: Move to a close detail contained in the parent action

entries.name: Cutaway
entries.mechanism: Temporary detail or parallel view conceals omitted time

entries.name: Invisible dark cut
entries.mechanism: Cut across full-frame darkness or silhouette

entries.name: Foreground occlusion cut
entries.mechanism: Use a passing body or object to conceal the edit

entries.name: Motion-blur hidden cut
entries.mechanism: Place edit during high blur at similar flow direction

entries.name: Composition hold / delayed cut
entries.mechanism: Hold a frame until the dramatic information changes
entries.failure_check: Holding without new information feels slack

entries.name: Cut after movement
entries.mechanism: Wait for action completion rather than cut on impact

entries.name: Insert-and-return
entries.mechanism: Cut to an insert then return on changed context
entries.creative_use: Story detail without a full scene change

entries.name: Reverse angle inversion
entries.mechanism: Deliberately swap axis after a clear spatial reset

entries.name: Graphic match
entries.mechanism: Align shapes or dominant composition between shots
entries.failure_check: Looks ornamental when meanings do not connect

entries.name: Subject match
entries.mechanism: Align subject types, poses, profiles or silhouettes

entries.name: Action match
entries.mechanism: Continue a specific movement through the cut
entries.creative_use: Carry momentum across time and space

entries.name: Direction match
entries.mechanism: Preserve consistent movement vectors across shots

entries.name: Speed match
entries.mechanism: Cut between objects sharing apparent screen velocity

entries.name: Scale match
entries.mechanism: Keep a focal object the same screen size across shots
entries.creative_use: Conceal change of location or object

entries.name: Color match
entries.mechanism: Connect similar chromatic focal regions
entries.failure_check: Color as sole reason often feels thin

entries.name: Luminance match
entries.mechanism: Connect highlight/shadow distribution

entries.name: Texture match
entries.mechanism: Align grain, weave, foam, fabric or surface patterns
entries.failure_check: VFX smoothness conflicts with physical texture

entries.name: Eye-position match
entries.mechanism: Maintain eye coordinates or eye-line direction

entries.name: Object-function match
entries.mechanism: Different objects perform the same physical task

entries.name: Cause-and-effect match
entries.mechanism: Cut from action to its distant consequence
entries.failure_check: Implies causal link not in script

entries.name: Conceptual / intellectual match
entries.mechanism: Juxtapose unlike images that share an idea

entries.name: Sound match
entries.mechanism: Join matching sound signatures over different sources

entries.name: Gesture / behavior rhyme
entries.mechanism: Match an actor's posture, hesitation or habitual gesture

entries.name: Negative-space match
entries.mechanism: Connect vacant areas of composition across two shots
entries.failure_check: Subject enters wrong side of frame

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Smash cut
entries.mechanism: Abrupt, high-contrast change in tone or intensity

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Jump cut
entries.mechanism: Remove intermediate action within near-matched framing

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Elliptical cut
entries.mechanism: Omit an expected narrative interval
entries.creative_use: Trust viewer inference and increase pace

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Time-jump match
entries.mechanism: Match composition across different days or years
entries.creative_use: Make a passage of time immediate

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Flash-forward cut
entries.mechanism: Briefly show a later known or hypothetical event

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Flashback bridge
entries.mechanism: Transition to a prior event with an earned perceptual link

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Crosscutting
entries.mechanism: Alternate actions in separate locations

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Parallel montage
entries.mechanism: Interleave separate events with thematic relation

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Associative montage
entries.mechanism: Link images by evolving idea rather than continuity

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Metric montage
entries.mechanism: Organize cut lengths by a measurable progression

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Rhythmic montage
entries.mechanism: Edit to movement patterns inside shots

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Tonal montage
entries.mechanism: Edit on emotional qualities across images

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Overtonal montage
entries.mechanism: Layer metric, rhythmic and tonal tensions

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Intellectual montage
entries.mechanism: Make a new argument by image collision

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Split chronology
entries.mechanism: Interlace stages of one event nonlinearly

entries.name: J-cut / audio pre-lap
entries.mechanism: Bring next shot or scene sound in before the image

entries.name: L-cut / audio post-lap
entries.mechanism: Let preceding shot's sound outlive its image

entries.name: Sound bridge
entries.mechanism: Carry a common ambience, effect or music bed over the cut

entries.name: Audio match cut
entries.mechanism: Align related sound events from distinct environments

entries.name: Acoustic morph
entries.mechanism: Gradually transform a sound's spectrum or envelope into another

entries.name: Reverb-tail bridge
entries.mechanism: Carry the decay of a voice or struck object into next image

entries.name: Hard silence cut
entries.mechanism: Remove ambience/music exactly at the image change

entries.name: Ambience swap
entries.mechanism: Change environmental bed ahead of or after picture
entries.creative_use: Signal a new location before reveal

entries.name: Dialogue bridge
entries.mechanism: Complete one conversation's line over a new setting
entries.failure_check: Implies direct dialog at wrong place

entries.name: Musical downbeat cut
entries.mechanism: Cut exactly on a strong musical attack

entries.name: Anticipation cut
entries.mechanism: Change picture before a predicted drum or lyric event

entries.name: Afterbeat cut
entries.mechanism: Delay picture past rhythmic emphasis

entries.name: Sonic perspective shift
entries.mechanism: Transition diegetic sound from internal to external viewpoint
entries.creative_use: Alter relationship to character or space

entries.name: Cross dissolve
entries.mechanism: Blend adjacent shots through opacity

entries.name: Film dissolve (linear light)
entries.mechanism: Blend exposure response in linear-light space

entries.name: Additive dissolve
entries.mechanism: Add bright regions across frames while mixing

entries.name: Non-additive dissolve
entries.mechanism: Blend without additive brightening bias

entries.name: Fade to black
entries.mechanism: Gradually diminish picture into black
entries.failure_check: Cliche if used at every scene

entries.name: Fade to white
entries.mechanism: Gradually increase to white

entries.name: Dip to color
entries.mechanism: Pass through a selected solid color

entries.name: Linear wipe
entries.mechanism: One image reveals another along moving boundary

entries.name: Diagonal wipe
entries.mechanism: Slanted boundary reveal across frames

entries.name: Iris in/out
entries.mechanism: Circle opens or closes visual field

entries.name: Clock / radial wipe
entries.mechanism: Pivot a radial wipe around image center

entries.name: Venetian-blind wipe
entries.mechanism: Repeated strips replace image

entries.name: Page turn / peel
entries.mechanism: Peel image as physical page

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Whip pan
entries.mechanism: End and begin adjacent shots with matched fast pan

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Whip tilt
entries.mechanism: Use fast upward/downward camera tilt

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Swish zoom
entries.mechanism: Fast focal zoom bridges shots

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Body/lens cover
entries.mechanism: Hand, hat, coat or moving person briefly covers lens

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Door-frame pass
entries.mechanism: Camera passes a doorway edge into another set

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Wall / pillar wipe
entries.mechanism: Architecture crosses the full lens area

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Floor-to-floor tilt
entries.mechanism: Tilt to uniform floor and reverse into another space

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Sky-to-sky tilt
entries.mechanism: Use featureless sky as neutral bridge

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Rack-focus blur bridge
entries.mechanism: Defocus outgoing image and sharpen the next

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Foreground pass-through
entries.mechanism: Let moving object pass extremely close to lens

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Prism/refraction pass
entries.mechanism: Sweep glass or prism across field to conceal next shot

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Mirror reveal
entries.mechanism: Track into a reflection then open on new setting

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Lens flare occlusion
entries.mechanism: Bright source veils frame at join

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Practical shutter close/open
entries.mechanism: Use physical lid, iris, curtain or aperture-like closing action

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Light leak
entries.mechanism: Use real or designed leak to cross cut

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Film burn
entries.mechanism: Let exposure-colored edge grow across frame

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Flash frame
entries.mechanism: Brief controlled exposure event around edit

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Strobe bridge
entries.mechanism: Alternate lit frames to change space

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Match flicker
entries.mechanism: Cut between two sources on coherent flicker phase

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Practical flare match
entries.mechanism: Match flaring fixtures across scenes

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Chroma wipe
entries.mechanism: Color field or gradient becomes matte

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Luma wipe
entries.mechanism: Reveal clip through ordered brightness regions

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Exposure-rack transition
entries.mechanism: Overexpose and recover into another image

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Color-field dip
entries.mechanism: Use exact environmental or design color to bridge

entries.name: Alpha matte reveal
entries.mechanism: Use animated shape/transparency to reveal next plate

entries.name: Rotoscope / actor wipe
entries.mechanism: Isolate actor crossing foreground as scene behind changes

entries.name: Depth-based wipe
entries.mechanism: Use depth estimates to reveal by distance

entries.name: Object replacement bridge
entries.mechanism: One object turns into a related asset across a hidden cut
